audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Levels 1-3 to Skill and Level 6 to Skill, while the prose says 'Sett owns these levels' early and 'The lane flips at 6'.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Sett/Sett/Skill/Skill/Gwen/Gwen/Gwen and matches the prose.
audit.corrected: Levels 1-2 to Sett, 4-5 to Skill, Level 6 to Gwen.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike rows were template text and none of Sett's abilities were named anywhere in the page.
audit.why: Packet flags 'never names any of Sett's abilities'. Real spikes are his charged Haymaker at 1-2, Facebreaker at 3, Gwen's Level 6 Mist, and Riftmaker into his HP stack.
audit.corrected: Pit Grit, Knuckle Down, Haymaker, Facebreaker and The Show Stopper now named with their cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated: Facebreaker's stun is conditional.
audit.why: Riot: 'Sett pulls in all enemies on opposite sides of him... If enemies were only on one side, they are slowed instead of stunned.' Alone on one side of him you are only slowed. Riot on Haymaker: 'dealing true damage in the center and physical damage on the sides' — the centre is the only part that ignores resistances. The Show Stopper is a 400-range targeted carry, so Hallowed Mist (targetable only from inside) denies his combo opener from outside.
audit.corrected: All three written into the phase whys, cooldown block, dos/donts and the interactions report row.

audit.why: Haymaker 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s, Facebreaker 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s — Facebreaker is the punishable one because it is his only opener.
audit.corrected: Both cooldowns written in; the punish window is now a whiffed Facebreaker.

edits.before: Stack snips on the wave and tag him with the true-damage center. Identify how Sett contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Sett owns level 1: Pit Grit's alternating punches out-stat your cone, and every hit you take charges his Haymaker. Farm the tip, feed nothing.

edits.before: E dash-attack-speed makes the snip window real. Only take the trade when Sett's Haymaker is down.
edits.after: Knuckle Down's two max-health hits plus a charged Haymaker beat your snips — give him no Grit at all.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Sett must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit online, but Facebreaker pulls from 490 and stuns. Keep a minion off your flank so you are never the middle of his pull.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Haymaker's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Facebreaker only stuns enemies on opposite sides of him — alone on one side you are merely slowed, so never stand between him and an ally.

edits.before: Needles ramp the longer the fight goes — extended brawls are yours. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Sett's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: The Show Stopper is a 400-range grab that sets up Haymaker. It is targeted, so from outside Hallowed Mist he cannot start the combo at all.

edits.before: Riftmaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Haymaker's cooldown.
edits.after: Riftmaker is your spike — his big HP bar is exactly what your %-max-HP snips were built to eat.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Sett carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: one Haymaker cannot out-burst your healing off a bar that big. Bring anti-heal for Pit Grit's regen.

edits.before: - Sett Haymaker: matchup-defining — His shield + true-damage burst. Mist it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Sett Haymaker (12-18s): true damage in the centre only — stand at the edge and it is just physical. - Facebreaker (10-16s): his stun and only opener; never be between him and an ally. - Needlework: kill windows only.

edits.before: Good trade: Stack passive on minions, E onto Sett with the center-Q ready, snip the %HP true damage, and W if he turns. Great trade: Sett wastes Haymaker — commit the full pattern immediately. Bad trade: Dropping W early or fighting outside it against his key tool — the mist IS the matchup for ranged answers.
edits.after: Good trade: Stack passive on minions, E onto Sett with the center-Q ready, snip the %HP true damage, and W if he turns. Great trade: Facebreaker whiffs — he has no pull for 10-16s, so commit the full pattern. Bad trade: feeding Grit into a full Haymaker bar and eating the true-damage centre with no Mist up.

edits.before: His shield + true-damage burst. Mist it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: True damage only in the centre — stand at the edge and eat physical instead.

edits.before: Sett wastes Haymaker — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Facebreaker stuns only if you and an ally flank him; else slow.

edits.before: That is Sett's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Every hit you take charges Grit into his Haymaker shield and true damage.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Facebreaker is 10-16s — dodge it and his whole combo has no opener.

edits.before: Dropping W early or fighting outside it against his key tool — the mist IS the matchup for ranged answers.
edits.after: Hallowed Mist is 18-22s and it is what denies The Show Stopper — never spend it on poke you can walk out of.

edits.before: Track Sett's Haymaker: His shield + true-damage burst. Mist it. When it is down — Snip him in your mist.
edits.after: Facebreaker stuns only across opposite sides; alone you are slowed. Haymaker's true damage is centre-only.

edits.before: Sett owns the early grit — his passive double-punch and a fully charged W (true-damage smash) out-trade your six-snip cone Q, so farm with the tip of Q and never feed his W bar.
edits.after: Sett owns the early grit — Pit Grit's alternating punches and a charged Haymaker (W) out-trade your six-snip cone Q, so farm at the tip of Q and never feed his Grit bar.

edits.before: Needlework plus Hallowed Mist flips it: bait his E grab or R, then step into your mist so he can't target the stored-W smash follow-up, and snip him while he's locked out.
edits.after: Needlework plus Hallowed Mist flips it: bait Facebreaker (E) or The Show Stopper (R) — R is targeted at 400, so from outside the mist he cannot even open the combo.

edits.before: Pre-mist you're a melee with no untargetability; his front-loaded grab-and-smash burst matches your poke, so play the resets carefully.
edits.after: Facebreaker (E) only stuns enemies on opposite sides of him — stand alone on one side and it is a slow, so never let a minion put you in the middle.

edits.before: Hit E grab-stun to pin you, then double-punch passive into a committed all-in before you can dash out
edits.after: Catch you opposite an ally with Facebreaker (E) so the pull stuns not slows, then Knuckle Down into the all-in

notes: Sett's kit file flags The Show Stopper as grounding, but Riot's description does not mention grounding — I did not assert it. Facebreaker's conditional stun (opposite sides only) is the highest-value fact in this matchup and was absent from both layers.
